name: Drake Hotline Bling
shows: Drake in an orange jacket holding up a hand to refuse one thing, then pointing and smiling at another.
use: Preferring one thing over another.

name: Two Buttons
shows: A sweating cartoon man trying to choose between two red buttons.
use: A hard choice between two options you want equally.

name: Distracted Boyfriend
shows: A man walking with his girlfriend turns to stare at another woman while the girlfriend looks at him, appalled.
use: Being tempted away from what you already have.

name: Bernie I Am Once Again Asking For Your Support
shows: Bernie Sanders in a winter coat, saying he is once again asking for your support.
use: Asking for something, yet again.

name: UNO Draw 25 Cards
shows: A person holding an UNO card that says do the thing or draw 25, and holding a huge pile of cards instead.
use: Someone who would rather suffer than do something simple.

name: Always Has Been
shows: Two astronauts in space: one looks at the Earth in surprise, the other points a gun at him and says always has been.
use: Revealing that something was true all along.

name: Left Exit 12 Off Ramp
shows: A car swerving across a motorway to take the exit, against the road sign.
use: Suddenly making an impulsive, worse choice.

name: Anakin Padme 4 Panel
shows: Four panels of Anakin and Padme in a meadow: she says something hopeful, he stares silently, and her smile drops.
use: A worrying silence after an innocent assumption.

name: Gru's Plan
shows: Gru presenting a plan on a flip chart over four panels, then staring in shock when the last step goes wrong.
use: A plan with a fatal flaw.

name: Epic Handshake
shows: Two muscular arms clasping hands in a mighty handshake.
use: Two different groups agreeing on one thing.

name: Disaster Girl
shows: A little girl smiling knowingly at the camera while a house burns behind her.
use: Quietly causing chaos.

name: Running Away Balloon
shows: A man reaching for a balloon labelled with what he wants while someone pulls him away.
use: Being held back from what you want.

name: Waiting Skeleton
shows: A skeleton sitting on a bench, having waited for a very long time.
use: Waiting forever for something.

name: Sad Pablo Escobar
shows: Three panels of Pablo Escobar sitting alone, looking lonely and bored.
use: Being lonely or bored while waiting.

name: X, X Everywhere
shows: Buzz Lightyear with an arm round Woody, pointing to the distance: X, X everywhere.
use: Something being absolutely everywhere.

name: Change My Mind
shows: Steven Crowder at a table outside with a sign saying change my mind.
use: Stating an opinion and daring people to argue.

name: Trade Offer
shows: A man in a suit with arms open in front of a blue background: trade offer, I receive, you receive.
use: Proposing a deal.

name: Y'all Got Any More Of That
shows: Dave Chappelle as a scruffy man asking: y'all got any more of that?
use: Wanting more of something.

name: Woman Yelling At Cat
shows: A tearful woman shouting and pointing, next to a confused white cat sitting at a dinner table with a plate of salad.
use: An argument where one side does not care.

name: Batman Slapping Robin
shows: Batman slapping Robin across the face mid-sentence.
use: Shutting down a bad idea or comment.

name: Mocking Spongebob
shows: SpongeBob bent over like a chicken, with text in alternating capitals.
use: Mocking what someone said.

name: Ancient Aliens
shows: A man with wild hair gesturing on a TV show: aliens.
use: Blaming something unexplainable on aliens.

name: Squidward window
shows: Squidward staring sadly out of his window at others having fun.
use: Watching others have fun without you.

name: One Does Not Simply
shows: Boromir from Lord of the Rings making a circle with his fingers: one does not simply.
use: Saying that something is much harder than it sounds.

name: Is This A Pigeon
shows: An anime man pointing at a butterfly and asking whether it is a pigeon.
use: Getting something completely wrong.

name: Oprah You Get A
shows: Oprah excitedly pointing at the audience: you get a car, everybody gets a car.
use: Giving something to everybody.

name: They're The Same Picture
shows: Pam from The Office holding up two pictures and saying they are the same picture.
use: Two things that are identical.

name: Buff Doge vs. Cheems
shows: A muscular buff shiba inu dog next to a small weak crying one.
use: Comparing how things were then with how they are now.

name: This Is Fine
shows: A cartoon dog in a hat sitting at a table with a cup of coffee while the room burns around him: this is fine.
use: Pretending everything is fine when it is not.

name: Expanding Brain
shows: A brain getting bigger and glowing brighter across panels next to ever sillier ideas.
use: Ideas that get more ridiculous while pretending to be smarter.

name: Tuxedo Winnie The Pooh
shows: Winnie the Pooh plain in one panel and in a tuxedo looking fancy in the next.
use: A posh way to say an ordinary thing.

name: Megamind peeking
shows: Megamind peeking up from the bottom of the frame asking: no?
use: Pointing out that someone lacks something.

name: Hide the Pain Harold
shows: An older man smiling for a stock photo while clearly hiding pain.
use: Smiling through suffering.

name: Roll Safe Think About It
shows: A man tapping his head with a knowing grin.
use: A clever but flawed piece of logic.

name: Monkey Puppet
shows: A monkey puppet glancing awkwardly to the side.
use: Awkward silence after being called out.

name: Clown Applying Makeup
shows: A man putting on clown makeup step by step over four panels.
use: Making yourself look foolish.

name: Spider Man Triple
shows: Three Spider-Men pointing at each other.
use: People accusing each other of the same thing.

name: spiderman pointing at spiderman
shows: Two Spider-Men pointing at each other in a room.
use: Two people or things that are exactly the same.

name: Boardroom Meeting Suggestion
shows: A boss asking for ideas around a table, then throwing the one sensible employee out of the window.
use: A good suggestion that nobody wants to hear.

name: Evil Kermit
shows: Kermit the Frog talking to a hooded dark version of himself.
use: Your worse self tempting you.

name: Bad Luck Brian
shows: A school photo of a smiling boy in braces and a sweater vest.
use: Terrible luck.

name: Domino Effect
shows: A tiny domino about to topple a giant one.
use: A small thing leading to a huge result.

name: Panik Kalm Panik
shows: Meme man panicking, then calm, then panicking again.
use: Feelings flipping as news changes.

name: Surprised Pikachu
shows: Pikachu with his mouth open in shock.
use: Being surprised by an obvious result.

name: Futurama Fry
shows: Fry from Futurama squinting suspiciously: not sure if.
use: Being unsure what is really going on.

name: Grim Reaper Knocking Door
shows: The grim reaper knocking on doors along a corridor.
use: Picking off things one by one.

name: Inhaling Seagull
shows: A seagull inhaling over several panels before screaming.
use: Building up to an outburst.

name: Scooby doo mask reveal
shows: Fred from Scooby-Doo pulling the mask off a villain to reveal who it really is.
use: Revealing what something really is.

name: Laughing Leo
shows: Leonardo DiCaprio laughing with a drink in his hand in Django Unchained.
use: Laughing at something.

name: Leonardo Dicaprio Cheers
shows: Leonardo DiCaprio in The Great Gatsby raising a glass of champagne.
use: A toast to something.

name: Absolute Cinema
shows: Martin Scorsese raising both hands in a black and white shot: absolute cinema.
use: Calling something a masterpiece.

name: Bike Fall
shows: A cyclist shoving a stick into his own wheel, then lying on the ground blaming someone else.
use: Causing your own problem.

name: Two guys on a bus
shows: Two men on a bus: one sad looking at a rock wall, the other happy looking at a view.
use: Two people seeing the same situation differently.

name: Sleeping Shaq
shows: Shaquille O'Neal asleep, then wide awake.
use: Ignoring one thing and waking up for another.

name: I Bet He's Thinking About Other Women
shows: A woman in bed thinking her partner is thinking about other women, while he lies awake thinking about something else.
use: Overthinking what someone is thinking.

name: Who Killed Hannibal
shows: Eric Andre shooting someone, then asking who would do this.
use: Blaming others for what you did.

name: The Rock Driving
shows: Dwayne Johnson in a car looking shocked at what his passenger said.
use: Reacting to something said.

name: Star Wars Yoda
shows: Yoda speaking wisdom.
use: Wise words, in reverse order.

name: Grandma Finds The Internet
shows: An older woman staring in amazement at a computer.
use: Discovering something new online.

name: Third World Skeptical Kid
shows: A child looking at the camera with a doubtful frown.
use: Doubting something.

name: Look At Me
shows: A man from Captain Phillips saying: look at me, I am the captain now.
use: Taking charge.

name: Gus Fring we are not the same
shows: Gus Fring from Breaking Bad: we are not the same.
use: Showing you are different from someone.
